notes.title: Punch Planet - Version 0.5.2.c
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/32d01b52fd3d4e07ebf4650280354789ec973f25.png[/img]
Version 0.5.2.c is now released! This update contains training mode improvements and some performance optimizations.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/e572ab093ffe28e7933593865b6d8f2d49980cd3.png[/img]

[b]Training Mode - Reversal Actions[/b]
Added the ability to have the training dummy perform actions after being struck or getting up from a knockdown. Players can choose up to five actions that will be done automatically. Actions can be chosen from a list of available moves per-character and are saved between game sessions.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/68f99952c9d241ed68f9345f6609614ce47008ca.jpg[/img]

This will be extremely helpful for players who want to learn the ins-and-outs of the game engine, by allowing them to set up specific situations in order to test their frame traps, knockdown setups, whiff punish spacing and more.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/d116f8eefc007258029b48ec11e7412e18290ea3.gif[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/68e04616b1ad64061ceb97cd1b1c42a386acb300.gif[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/07bdf345361857424d82be18df62c4ad31ac0a50.gif[/img]

This implementation is pretty good but it doesn't quite allow for testing of [i]all the situations[/i], but it will be serviceable for a majority of use cases. Eventually we will add support for recording your own actions, but setting up the UX for that is substantially more work.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/787ba55cceb538971b84d55145509dab0fe8a51f.gif[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/fa3458fbb1ed28ef4c24b73ea3b92e90d393e4e9.gif[/img][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/372afc06a2ea632e1e93ec583525d6591bc99cf2.gif[/img]

[b]Training Mode - Block Type "First"[/b]
Added ability to set the training dummy to block the first attack of a sequence, and get hit by the rest. This allows players to test situations where their first hit is blocked but their followup attack lands.

[b]Training Mode - Block Type "Auto" Updated[/b]
Updated auto blocking logic for the training dummy, which should cover some situations that were previously not working:
[list]
[*]Will now block when being air-reset
[*]Will now block when rising from a knockdown
[*]Will now block when being hit with a mid->low true-blockstring
[/list]
[b]Training Mode - KO Enabled[/b]
Added ability to KO opponents in training mode.

[b]Training Mode - Health Start Settings[/b]
Added ability to set the starting and refresh value for health.

[b]Training Mode - Health Regen Settings[/b]
Added ability to toggle whether health regenerates or not in training mode.

[b]Training Mode - Per Player Settings[/b]
All above player settings in addition to T-Meter, E-Meter, and Maxx-HappyHour settings, are now settable per-player. Can be helpful if a player wants to practice with unlimited meter against a cpu that doesn't.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/ea5ca66f12c02f07a29143b58908e6decb68df75.jpg[/img]

[b]Training Mode - Updated Health / Meter Refresh Logic[/b]
Updated logic that controls when health and meter is refreshed so that it's more consistent and correct. These will now only refresh once the player has returned to a neutral state and does not initiate another move.

[b]Training Mode - Added Game Timer[/b]
Added option for turning on the game timer.

[b]General Optimizations[/b]
Made some low-level code optimizations to the move and input controllers that should make these a bit faster. These functions get called many times per frame when trying to figure out which move needs to be used, and the improvements should make the game feel snappier and help with rollback situations (very cpu dependant).

These changes have been added to the main Version 0.5.2 change-log, [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1T5_0qsthmjn9-infZYLQNDnIoi_f-R5bkCLaXRflcY0/edit?usp=sharing]which can be found here.[/url]

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/89c7d7efa40b698d469db488bf1aaa2b50d30546.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/14004433f09df74c4bb61af17d1930244c1213ab.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/6bb92ecb2e53de699a5b79146f1f2bb8bb4eaf17.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/659f650dd259d2cb8d56340199de15817233d3cc.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/13de01a5936dc1778bbff82dea978c28a9e6b90b.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/ce88ff3a9400468373d0c0ca41037fed6ce2f19a.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/f3c3aa45fb4da561faf3f0828fc469807cb6c8e4.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/11ea40ca82bcabb929ce31e7b7066c973888ca77.jpg[/img][/url][url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/ba3fc263398589f05089cc74a29864344f102f3e.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/ee80b20857fad2f8a66563c0ab8ae5a82eef12aa.jpg[/img][/url]

Here's a bit of footage of both the costumes in action
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=auLgCbJ14fc&feature=youtu.be

These costumes are now available for all Early Access owners! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/e572ab093ffe28e7933593865b6d8f2d49980cd3.png[/img]
Also included in this update are some improvements to the lobby system, main menu music changes, and some small balance adjustments.

[b]Online - Lobby Improvements[/b]
We've made a few small improvements to the lobby functionality.

Players can now choose to move themselves down in the rotation queue. If a player has someone behind them in the rotation, they now have the option to switch places with that person and give them their spot. This can be repeated until the player is at the end of the queue. 

Lobby hosts can now update the settings of their lobby after it has been created. Size and privacy can now be set without requiring the host to leave and create a new lobby.

With the above changes, we also adjusted the visuals of the lobby and in-game spectator pause dialogs. The "Leave Rotation" button is now on the left side along with the other buttons and new buttons, and new labels have been inserted into the player list to divide between current players, players that are in the rotation, and players who are only spectating.

[b]Main Menu Music[/b]
If the main menu is left to idle for a certain amount of time, the music will now transition into random stage songs.

[b]Benchmarking Tool[/b]
Added a benchmarking tool to the graphics options. This will help players tune their graphics settings for their hardware, and provide us with a standardized environment for testing for performance discrepancies between characters and stages. Players can choose character / stage / music settings and allow the CPU to fight against itself at the fastest speed your computer can go, and are graded based on fast it performs. Choosing the same character settings will result in the same exact playback (between runs and between machines), so feel free to compare with other players.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/52d4d9e1f334f503f7242653afec79f88ecbc330.png[/img]
[b]Battle Camera[/b]
Gameplay camera now moves faster horizontally.

[b]Character Shake[/b]
Disabled the character shake that happens when collisions happen, wasn't really working out. Will possibly revisit at another time with a different implementation.

notes.title: Punch Planet - Version 0.5.2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/e40d05676a547fe22f8d206bf1de219a7e3039d6.png[/img]
Version 0.5.2 is now released!

This patch includes visual fx improvements, skippable intros, gameplay ui changes, depth of field adjustments, gameplay balance tweaks, and some other small polish things. Full changelog can be found [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1T5_0qsthmjn9-infZYLQNDnIoi_f-R5bkCLaXRflcY0/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vr7kEeBp5lM

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/e572ab093ffe28e7933593865b6d8f2d49980cd3.png[/img]
[b]Visual Improvements - Improved Character FX[/b]
The effect that happens with characters' clones when they use T-meter and E-meter has been improved. When using universal mechanics, the blue dissolve now looks better when fading in and out. EX and Super moves are now accompanied by a scan-line effect on the clone. This should help make their two uses feel more distinct and look cooler.

[b]Visual Improvements - Super Freeze[/b]
Re-introduced the background lines that become visible when using a Super attack. The technique for rendering these has been changed from using particles to using a shader with scrolling textures, should be more performant and look better.

[b]Visual Improvements - Meter Bar Improvements[/b]
Meter bar art assets have been updated.

[b]Visual Improvements - "Shiny" Characters[/b]
Certain character materials can now be "shiny", like Agent's armor and Roy's gun.

[b]Visual Improvements - Depth Of Field[/b]
The depth of field effect that we've been using during super freeze has been functionally changed. Previously this would toggle on while zooming in on a character during a super or command grab in order to focus on the characters a bit more. Now it is an always-on background effect, used to help give more depth to the far-background elements and also helps the characters "pop" out a bit more.

[b]Visual Improvements - Stage Lighting[/b]
All stages have had their lighting adjusted, should give the characters more depth and look better.

[b]Intros - Now Skippable[/b]
Players can now skip their own character intros in versus modes by pressing the start button.

[b]Character Select - Saves Local Selections[/b]
Character select will now retain character, costume, color, stage, and music options between matches when playing locally. Settings are reset when changing game modes (Versus -> Practice, etc).

[b]Settings Files - Format Change[/b]
The format for all the local settings files has changed from XML to JSON. These will now be more human readable and easier to use on the engine side, but your settings will all be reset to default, sorry!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/52d4d9e1f334f503f7242653afec79f88ecbc330.png[/img]
[b]Battle Camera[/b]
Adjusted the camera to be slightly more 2D feeling. Field of view got slightly smaller, distance zoomed slightly closer, no more depth change when jumping.

[b]Character Shake[/b]
Slightly adjusted the character shake when players take hits, should be a bit more subtle.

[b]Hit Stop[/b]
Slightly increased medium, heavy, and special attacks' hit stop. With the previous decrease, it made the execution speed for special cancels just a little bit too quick. This is a fine line but we're pretty close to where we want it.

[b]Push Back[/b]
Slightly increased the push back speed scale, characters should seem like they get pushed back faster than before (same total distance however).

[b]Walk Speed Ramp[/b]
Slightly increased the total frames that walk speed gets ramped up from 6 to 10 frames. This will mean that characters will take 4 more frames to reach their maximum walk speed. With this in mind, we've also slightly increased most characters' walk speed so that their max speed is higher than before.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/0e4383a8ae2bffc701dff1d12c03e6f64a5fad0d.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Walks: Slightly faster walk forward and walk backward
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/2b0b4cda21d54021697cf922acf4ebf0ae98c14d.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Walks: Slightly faster walk forward and walk backward
[*]Charged normal attacks: Now gain meter on use
[*]St.LK: Faster startup
[*]Cr.MK: Better hit box for beating opponents directly above/behind
[*]Cr.HP: Worse hit box for beating opponents directly above/behind

[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/509c3f7adeb8a75b5d4848eabddd7e0d61ae7e11.png[/img]
[list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/8a8a68451c27b7e8acd7cbb7aedb23fff748cc4e.png[/img]
[list]

[*]Walks: Slightly faster walk forward and walk backward

[*]Jp.MK: More time between each hit, adjusted first hit collision boxes

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/2789edef5fddc7c00557ab34419c5fabb43619c4.png[/img]
[list]

[*]Forward Throw: Increased recovery, decreased knockdown distance,
[*]Backward Throw: Increased recovery
[*]St.LP: Less push back, less recovery
[*]Cr.LP: Less push back, less recovery, less hit stun
[*]St.LK: Slightly farther hit box
[*]St.MP: Slower startup, less followthrough / recovery, retracted collision boxes, less hit stun, less block stun

That's it for the main changes in the update, but as always, there's a ton of little things in the full detailed changelog, [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1T5_0qsthmjn9-infZYLQNDnIoi_f-R5bkCLaXRflcY0/edit?usp=sharing]which you can find here[/url]

notes.title: Punch Planet - Version 0.5.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/4734c13eb4e00efb4f30e4d48b0ef667b3e90650.png[/img]

Version 0.5.1 is now released! This patch contains new CPU versus mode, more training room features, a demo mode, and as always more gameplay improvements.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PY7JhoPBkWk



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/e572ab093ffe28e7933593865b6d8f2d49980cd3.png[/img]

[b]CPU Versus Mode[/b]
Added CPU / AI functionality! Players can now fight against computer opponents in versus mode and training mode. 

There are three difficulties to choose from (Easy / Medium / Hard), the difference between them is that the harder difficulties block more often, tech throws more often, make decisions quicker, and react to things faster. 

There is also two behaviour types to choose from. One is the Default option where they will use all their moves, and the other is a Footsie option where they will just use movement and a select few normals (can be fun to practice against). 

The AI itself is not particularly smart, but sometimes it does cool things and decently fun to fight against for a version 1.0. In the future we plan on improving on this and adding more behaviour types to fight against. Soon we will also add other game modes like survival and arcade.

Also, Maxx cheats (doesn't need charge)

[b]Demo Mode[/b]
Added a demonstration mode that creates random cpu vs cpu matches, and initiates automatically from the press start screen if no input is supplied. There are no intros or outros, and pressing start at any time will bring the game back to the main menu.

[b]Training Mode - Dummy[/b]
Added functionality for selecting the behaviour of the training dummy in the "Dummy Settings" sub-menu. The available options are:
[list]
[*]Default (Counter Hit / Blocking)
[*]Jump
[*]Crouch
[*]CPU (Difficulty / Type)
[*]Human
[*]Record
[*]Playback
[/list]

[b]Training Mode - Quick Change[/b]
Moved quick character / stage / music selection to a sub-menu under "Quick Change". Also added the ability to select character color from this menu.

[b]Training Mode - Functions[/b]
Added a "Functions" menu to the training mode which serves as a way to access the keyboard-mappable training keys from a controller. This will allow players to Pause / Step / Toggle Playback / Toggle Recording / Save Game State / Load Game State with their controller, which before was only possible from the keyboard.

While in training mode:
[list]
[*]Open the dialog by holding the "Utility" button (previously mapped to the load game state functionality)
[*]While continuing to hold the Utility button, move up and down to select the desired function
[*]Release the Utility button to execute or Start button to cancel
[*]Tap the Utility button in-game to repeat the last selected function (map to load game state and it will function same as before by tapping)
[/list]
This menu can also be accessed through the pause menu under "Functions".

[b]Training Mode - UI[/b]
Adjusted how the sub-menu options work (player / dummy / display / etc). Changed to just being separate sub menus instead of being a left / right group, which was kinda unintuitive how we had it set up.

[b]Patches Dialog[/b]
Removed the in-game patch viewing dialogs. Was kind of a pain to maintain and I doubt anyone actually uses them. In the future if I bring it back, it will probably just link to these steam announcement posts.

[b]Optimizations[/b]
Bunch of code optimizations done to improve memory performance, should feel smoother as a result (less intermittent hitching).


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/52d4d9e1f334f503f7242653afec79f88ecbc330.png[/img]

[b]Animations - Airborne hits improved[/b]
All characters have had their airborne being hit animations (reset / juggle / knockback) updated. This should provide more clarity for resets and generally look better than before.

[b]Attacks - Airborne normal pushback increased[/b]
All airborne attacks now apply slightly more push back against grounded opponents. Should look better and is slightly tied to the changes in jump arcs (read below).

[b]Camera - Adjustments[/b]
As always in searching for the perfect camera, ours has been adjusted against. This version should feel more 2D, move slower horizontally, move less vertically, clamps the top position (doesn't go above a certain height), and generally should be more clear.

[b]Character Shake - Re-enabled[/b]
Re-enabled the character shake that happens when a character gets hit and should be a bit more subtle than it used to be. Hopefully gives attacks a little bit more umpfh.

[b]Collision Boxes - Move Boxes - High speed resolutions[/b]
Added support to the engine that prevents characters from passing through each other at high speeds. This has been a pretty long-standing problem that has been pretty limiting and we finally got around to addressing it. 

Previously, if a character moved quick enough in one frame so that they moved farther than the width of their movement boxes, they would end up passing through the other. In order to prevent this, we generally just made the width of movement boxes relatively large and made sure that animations weren't too fast, but there were still some cases where it was possible to happen.

Now we can account for this, where the engine takes the previous frame's positions into account when figuring out if there was a movement collision and which side each player needs to be on. This will give us a lot more freedom with move box widths where we can make the characters "thinner", and with attack animation speed where characters can move much much faster without having to worry about going through the opponent.

[b]Collision Boxes - Move Boxes - Corner adjustment[/b]
Removed the logic that prevented characters from crossing under a juggled opponent in the corner. This was done so that things like Juggle xx DTC -> Forward Dash -> Attack would keep them in the corner even if the attacker got all the way into the corner.

This is being changed in order to allow that juggle cross under (stuff like Dog St.HK xx Run will allow the same mixups in the corner as it does mid screen), and any situation like the above one will be balanced more around the push back on the juggle and dash distance of the character.

[b]Collision Boxes - Move Boxes - Standardized Airborne / Juggle sizes[/b]
Standardized the bottom move box position between airborne and juggle states. Previously, the juggle version would reach quite a bit farther down to be harder to get under, but it allowed a strange-looking case to happen when a character gets hit while right on top of the other (one above the other and not intersecting -> get hit into juggle and is now intersecting because it reaches lower -> jarring resolution), most frequent example is Agent uppercutting against a very deep opponent.

Now it should feel a lot more consistent and look better.

Also, the back side of all airborne move boxes has been shrunk a bit, which makes it less often to collide with things that are behind the player. This will be mostly noticeable when landing directly on top of an opponent and landing on the other side (crossup), now when the character hits the ground they will be much closer because their movement box doesn't push out as much, should make empty jump crossups much much better.

[b]Collision Boxes - Move Boxes - Adjusted grounded heights[/b]
Dog has had the height of his grounded move boxes slightly reduced, and the Big body characters (T.Yara / Maxx) have had theirs slightly increased. This should slightly increase the difference between the body types.

[b]Collision Boxes - Grab / Move Boxes - Reduced grounded widths[/b]
With the above change to high speed move boxes, all body types have had their move box widths decreased (and grab boxes by the same amount - they are tied).

In relation to this, the hurt box widths have NOT been adjusted. Because of this, the horizontal distance between the edge of the move box and the hurt box has been increased, which means that all characters will get slightly more combo options when starting a combo from point-blank range.

[b]Damage - Ignore global and character scaling[/b]
Added functionality for defining if a hit has its damage scaled or not. Normal Throws, Command Throws, and Supers all are no longer scaled by global / character scale values and have had their damage values adjusted accordingly. These meta of these moves will no longer be affected when adjusting those scale values, and eventually if we want to move away from the scaling system we now have the ability to do so.

[b]Damage - Removed counter hit scaling bonus[/b]
Counter-hits no longer provide the benefit of not scaling the next hit in a combo. The damage variance on combos was just too much but it was fun for a while.

[b]Damage - Adjusted scaling[/b]
Slightly increased the global damage scale so that hits generally do a bit more damage and adjusted combo scaling so that there is a larger change between the first and second hits of a combo. This change should give a bit more reward to neutral hits in relation to combos.

[b]Damage - Supers separate scaling[/b]
Supers now use a separate linear scaling list (100% -> 90% -> 80% -> 70% -> 60% -> 50%). This change should give more reward to quick combos into supers.

[b]Hit Stop - Adjusted[/b]
Slightly increased all non-special-cancellable normals hit stop. This is something we've had in the past and gives these attacks slightly more umpfh, and in the case of super-cancellable attacks, slightly more time to buffer super.

[b]Input - More wakeup leniency[/b]
Slightly increased wake up input leniency, which should make it a little easier for players to get their attacks out when getting off the ground.

[b]JTC - Adjustments[/b]
JTC has been changed in a few ways that should give it a bit more utility but a bit less effective in neutral. The juggle value that you gain when landing it in a combo has been increased from 1 to 2, which will allow for more combo options after the JTC. On the other hand, it now scales the combo damage much more than before. Hopefully it should make going for these combos more about situational meter usage or player variety, rather than optimal damage.

[b]Jumps - Arc adjustments[/b]
All characters jump slightly farther horizontally, and slightly less high vertically.

[b]KO - More freeze[/b]
There is slightly more character freeze when KOs happen, should give the KO moment a bit more impact.

[b]Meter - Reduced[/b]
Slightly reduced E and T meter gain across the board, should make spending these resources a bit more of a risk and make 4-bar supers a bit harder to build.

[b]Resets - Adjustments[/b]
Decreased global reset juggle value from 3 to 2. This should allow more opportunities for resets, and with the above change to JTC juggle value, always after a JTC.

Each character has also had their reset distance slightly increased, which will make it harder to cross under and less reward in general.

[b]UI - Adjustments[/b]
Adjusted scaling resolution and positioning of the gameplay UI. Text should be more readable and look better.

[b]Walks - Added speed ramp[/b]
Added functionality for walk speed to ramp up over a few frames. This will slightly reduce the distance moved when quickly going between different directions. When initiating a walk, the movement speed will now start at 50% and ramp up to 100% over six frames. With this in mind, all characters have had their walk speed slightly increased. 



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/0e4383a8ae2bffc701dff1d12c03e6f64a5fad0d.png[/img]
[list]
[*]Jp.HP: Can no longer cross up
[*]St.HK: More push back, less corner push back
[*]HP.Gunshot: More hitboxes added to the end of the beam
[*]All.Headbutts: Less push back
[*]HK.Headbutt: More punishable on block
[*]EX.Headbutt: Travels farther during startup
[/list]



[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/2b0b4cda21d54021697cf922acf4ebf0ae98c14d.png[/img]
[list]
[*]General: Gains less meter

notes.title: Punch Planet - Version 0.4.1.a
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/9f2cc2a82b2fcc86d3516d01e1b322e84c46a117.png[/img]
Version 0.4.1.a is now released, it's a big one! We will try to highlight the big changes here but as always you can read the whole detailed change log at the bottom of the post.




[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/e572ab093ffe28e7933593865b6d8f2d49980cd3.png[/img]
[b]Online Lobbies / Spectating[/b]
This update contains some pretty hefty improvements to our online functionality! Players can now compete in rotation king-of-the-hill style with up to 7 other players, and spectate matches that are in progress. 

Current features of the lobby system:
[list]
[*]Players can leave the rotation if they wish to only spectate
[*]If only two players are in the rotation, players can rematch as much as they want
[*]Players will be automatically skipped if AFK
[*]Lobbies can be private and steam friends can join or be invited
[*]Steam profiles can now be viewed
[*]Total amount of players online is now shown
[/list]
This is pretty much version 1 of the new online stuff and next we will work towards matchmaking queues (from the menu or training) and more persistent data (like wins, losses, and rank, etc).

[b]Cid Art Updates[/b]
Much like Roy with the last version, Cid has had her entire animation library updated and brought up to the current generation of tech. She now has animated swipes and special ones for using her electric attacks, completely filled out secondary animation for her side grenades and dog tags, and in general a polish pass on the animations themselves. Along with that she has probably had the most gameplay changes which are detailed in the character section.

[b]Menu UI Changes[/b]
Changed the animations and layouts for all menus in the game, should be a bit faster, smoother to navigate, and look a bit better.

[b]Keyboard Configuration[/b]
Added support for mapping the keyboard. In the controls options, alongside the controller options there are now options for mapping keyboard keys for Player 1, Player 2, and Training Mode functions. Player 2 now defaults to un-mapped and will need to be mapped to be used.

[b]Menu Input[/b]
There is no longer a separate (un-mappable) set of inputs for controlling the menu versus controlling in game, now whatever your inputs are mapped they will be used for the menu as well.

[b]Training Mode - Playback and GameState[/b]
Removed Playback and GameState UIs and options to enable, and added a popup that shows when any of the functions are triggered. There will eventually be a way to access this stuff from the menu but for now it will need to be just the keyboard mappings.

[b]Training Mode - Maxx Happy Hour Toggle[/b]
Added toggle in training mode to disable Maxx's 4-bar automatic super "Happy Hour", now you can choose to practice buffed or not with meter options enabled.

[b]Sound Options - Mute when Alt-Tabbed[/b]
Added sound option for toggling if alt-tabbing causes the game to mute or not.




[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/52d4d9e1f334f503f7242653afec79f88ecbc330.png[/img]
There is a ton of adjustments to the gameplay in this one and we'll try to highlight the major changes.

[b]Chained Light Attacks[/b]
Light attacks that can chain cancel into other light attacks can no longer do so if the attack was parried. Previously, these moves had to have their chain timings restricted with regards to parry in order for them to still be negative when countered. Since they can no longer chain, we can get a little more freedom on the chain timing and speed it up in some cases.

[b]ATC - Less Hitstop[/b]
Hit stop across the board for almost all parried moves has been reduced by around 2 frames. Defenders will need to react slightly faster if they want to counter attacks.

[b]ATC - Orients Correctly on Crossups[/b]
When parrying a crossup, the defender will now orient towards the attacker instead of away (like normal hits), should just look better.

[b]JTC - Less Reward[/b]
The universal overhead JTC mechanic has been adjusted a bit in order to slightly reduce it's reward on hit.
[list]
[*]Two more active frames
[*]First two active frames will no longer hit against crouching opponents
[*]Less hit stun. Less advantageous against standing opponents and counter hits are now only combo-able against crouching opponents
[*]Horizontal distance is slightly decreased
[*]Push back is slightly decreased
[/list]

[b]Special Move Meter Gain[/b]
All specials moves now grant their meter for initiating them on the second frame instead of the first. This ensures that you do not gain meter for kara-cancelling a normal-special into an ex-special.

[b]Collision Boxes - Empty Jump Hurt Boxes Reach Lower[/b]
Empty jumps have had their hurt boxes slightly extended downwards. This should make them easier to hit by defenders.

[b]Collision Boxes - Shorter Standing Characters[/b]
All characters hurt boxes are slightly shorter when standing. This will make air to ground attacks need to be timed slightly later than before.

[b]Collision Boxes - Wider Hurt Boxes When Crouching[/b]
All characters have had their crouching hurt boxes slightly extended. There will now be a greater difference between standing / crouching hurt box distances and allow for more things to work against crouching opponents.

[b]Battle Camera[/b]
The game camera changed a little bit. Horizontally it will move smoother and a bit slower, and vertically it will move higher and slightly slower.

[b]Damage[/b]
Damage in the game has been adjusted slightly. Counter hits now grant +25% damage instead of +10%, supers minimum scaling increased from 50% to 55%, and the combo scaling values have been reduced a bit in order to limit longer combos a bit.

[b]Crossups - Physical Collisions[/b]
When crossups happen and players are intersecting with their movement boxes, the scale at which this is resolved has been increased from 0.5 to 1.0, which effectively disables this feature. This was used so that when players jumped almost directly on top of the other and landed behind, that they would not be pushed so far away when landing on the ground. With changes to the jump velocities and movement box sizes, this is no longer needed and looks much better.

[b]Crossups - Corner Non-Crossups[/b]
When both players are in the corner and one is jumping onto the other, non-crossup attacks will now land on the defender. Previously, if a move was not considered a move that can hit crossup, it would completely whiff and the attacker would land inside the corner.

[b]Crossups - Airborne Proximity Origin[/b]
The origin position for all attacks' proximity boxes has been extended so that it doesn't come from the exact middle of a character. This doesn't really change anything for grounded attacks, but for airborne attacks that landing right above the defender it should help and avoid proximity blocking putting a character in a weird flipping situation (proximity block -> get crossed up -> walk back into the front -> proximity block again -> etc).

[b]Crossups - Blocking Input Check Improvements[/b]
How the input for blocking is stored and referenced by the engine is now done as a unique case instead of like any other input, and is now calculated immediately before processing the collision logic for a hit. This fixes an unblockable case when being crossed up on the same frame that a move hits.

[b]Crossups - Less Pushback When Crossing Up[/b]
Added a scale value that can be applied to an attack's push back only when hitting as a crossup. Set to 0.5, this means that moves that hit crossup will only apply 50% of their push back instead of 100%. 

Previously, depending on a character's jump velocity, the character's move boxes, the attack's hit boxes, and the attack's push back, an attack could easily hit in front and land behind, or hit behind and land in front. Because of this, airborne attacks that could cross up needed to have their hit boxes and push back finely tuned to prevent it from happening. Due to that delicate balance, any change to a character's jump arc would have a strong chance of messing it up and re-introducing the case. It also meant that all the airborne normals needed different push back distances because they had different hit box sizes.

With the new method, we're able to standardize the push back distance for all airborne attacks (set to 2.0, which is higher than most crossup normals had before), and then scale it to 1.0 when it hits as a crossup (lower than crossup normals had before), and avoid this case and delicate balance all together.

[b]Hit Stop - Adjustments[/b]
Hit stop for medium and heavy attacks have been decreased slightly, and slightly increased for specials. This should speed up the combat when using normals, and give more impact and better cancelability for specials.

[b]Meter Gain - Adjustments[/b]
Global meter scaling has been increased from 125% to 150% but the curve for how it scales during a combo has been reduced. Players should gain more meter for stray hits and less for combos.

[b]Input - Charge Super Input[/b]
Charge super can now be done with the first forward input being any forward instead of strict forward. This means you can now input charge super with DownBackward -> DownForward -> DownBackward -> Forward.

[b]Input - Charge Buffer Increased[/b]
Amount of frames to charge for a charge move has been slightly increased from 40 to 44, requiring a bit more charge time for specials / supers.

[b]Input - Post-DTC Attack Leniency[/b]
When DTCing, leniency for the followup attack has been slightly increased from 12 to 14, making it a bit easier to do combos with.




[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/6a5fefdfde8b971fae38e16a8205e70eea61d6f5.png[/img]
It's been a while now since we've had a proper gameplay patch and this one has quite a bit of changes. Below you will find some changes that are applied to the characters as a whole, and then their individual changes.

[b]Walk Forward - Slight Speed Decrease[/b]
All characters have had their forward walk speeds slightly reduced, generally by the same amount so that their differences remain intact. Felt like it was a bit too easy for characters to invade each other's space.

[b]Walk Backward - Slight Speed Increase[/b]
Similar but opposite of the walk forward change, some characters have had their backwards walk speeds slightly increased. This should make the differences between forward and backwards and bit less drastic overall.

[b]Dash Forward - Slight Distance Decrease[/b]
Many characters have had their forward dash distance slightly reduced, they will cover a bit less ground.

[b]Jumps - Faster Startup[/b]
All characters have had their jump startup frames decreased to 4. This is a reduction from 5 for all characters other than TYara, who was reduced from 7. This should allow characters to get into the air faster.

[b]Jumps - Longer Air Time[/b]
With the above reduction in startup, these frames have been applied to the airborne time of the jump. The total amount of frames should be unchanged but will give the character more time to attack and the defender more time to react.

[b]Jumps - Higher Arcs[/b]
Character's have had their jump arcs height increased. This means that they will leave the ground at a faster speed, reach a higher point, and hit the ground at a faster speed. This will make jumping characters need to time their attacks a bit better, and also allow grounded defending characters a better chance to counter.

[b]Grounded Light Punches - Increased Block Stun[/b]
Most grounded light punch attacks have had their block stun increased. This should allow better advantage when going for a followup attack when blocked.

[b]Grounded Normal Attacks - Hurt Box Adjustments[/b]
Many grounded normal attacks have had their hurt boxes adjusted during their active and followthrough states. In general during active frames, hit boxes should extend farther than their hurt box counter part, and during followthrough, hurt boxes can sometimes extend farther than the hit box did during the active frames. This means that attacks can be whiff punished from a greater distance than they would hit and should be an improvement to whiff punishing and footsies in general.

[b]Airborne Normal Attacks - Standardized Pushback[/b]
All airborne attacks now apply the same amount of push back. Up until now it was on a per-move basis. This should feel more consistent when landing air-to-ground attacks.

[b]Airborne Normal Attacks - Increased Block Stun[/b]
Most airborne normal attacks have had their block stun slightly increased. This should allow better advantage when trying to follow up with a grounded attack when blocked.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/0e4383a8ae2bffc701dff1d12c03e6f64a5fad0d.png[/img]
Roy is in a pretty good spot overall, his changes are mostly in line with the global changes and a few new things.
[list]
[*]Forward walk is slower
[*]Backward walk is faster
[*]Forward dash doesn't go as far
[*]Light punches chain faster and are better on block
[*]St.LK is faster
[*]St.MP is better on hit and block
[*]Cr.MP forces stand and is better on block
[*]St.MK is faster
[*]St.HP has better hitbox
[*]Cr.HP reaches farther
[*]Jp.HP is better on block
[*]St.HK charged version is faster
[*]Cr.HK goes farther
[*]Jp.HK is slightly worse
[*]Gunshot light version no longer hits agent fireballs
[*]Gunshot medium has less push back
[*]Gunshot heavy juggles less far
[*]Headbutts have more push back on block and better advantage on block
[*]Super Gunshot has more active frames
[*]Super KnuckleSandwich no longer moves forward during active frames
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/2b0b4cda21d54021697cf922acf4ebf0ae98c14d.png[/img]
Cid has changed the most out of the characters and she has gained a few more tools.
[list]
[*]Art is completely updated (model and animations)
[*]Damage scale is slightly reduced
[*]Health is slightly reduced
[*]Forward walk is slower
[*]Forward dash doesn't go as far
[*]St.LP is no longer cancellable
[*]Cr.LP has less push back
[*]St.LK cancels into St.MP / Cr.MP slower and the advantage is different
[*]St.MP and St.HP can now be backdashed out of while holding
[*]St.MP(Normal) is better on block
[*]St.MP(Charged) is better on hit but worse on block
[*]Cr.MP(Normal) has less range
[*]Cr.MP(Charged) has more range
[*]St.MK reaches farther
[*]Cr.MK is slightly less effective
[*]Cr.HP has better hit box
[*]St.HK is better on block
[*]Grenades have less active frames but have had their speeds adjusted
[*]KnifeRush heavy version has a higher juggle value
[*]KnifeWheel animation is much more indicative when it is safe
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/509c3f7adeb8a75b5d4848eabddd7e0d61ae7e11.png[/img]
Not a whole lot changed with T.Yara, she will be the focus of our next update, but for now she got a few gameplay adjustments.
[list]
[*]Damage scale is slightly reduced
[*]Forward dash doesn't go as far
[*]St.LP has a higher hit box
[*]Cr.LP can chain faster
[*]Jp.LP is better on block
[*]St.LK is more whiff punishable
[*]Cr.LK has less range
[*]Jp.LK has a higher hit box
[*]Cr.MP is faster but less range
[*]Jp.MP is better on block
[*]St.MK has fixed hurt boxes
[*]Cr.MK has more range but is slower and worse on block
[*]Jp.MK can no longer crossup and is better on block
[*]Cr.HP got a better juggle
[*]Jp.HP is better on block
[*]St.HK is more whiff punishable
[*]Jp.HK has more active frames and is better on block
[*]Jp.Splash has a higher hit box but is better on block
[*]ShieldCharges can no longer be DTC'd, are now super cancellable, are now airborne, have less push back, and charged versions are better on block
[*]FlyingGoddesses have had their oki adjusted
[*]BreakYourBones have had their oki adjusted and normal have been slowed down
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/8a8a68451c27b7e8acd7cbb7aedb23fff748cc4e.png[/img]
Not a whole lot different with Dog other than some small adjustments, shouldn't really play any differently.
[list]
[*]Forward walk is slower
[*]Jp.LP is better on block
[*]Jp.LK is better on block but has a worse hit box
[*]St.MP has had its' target combo timing adjusted, is better on hit and on block
[*]Cr.MP is more whiff punishable
[*]St.MK second hit will now beat a parry -> jab
[*]Cr.MK has less push back

[*]Dw.Fw.HP is better on block

[*]Run->LeapStrike both versions stay on the ground slightly longer
[*]PinWheel->Dive all versions now have correct CH bonus, worse on hit and block
[*]Super PinWheel now hits lower
[*]Super Run is now a 4-bar super
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/9d760d0c577976cf93f3fba88ba77955861eb2b4.png[/img]
Agent-G has received a fair bit of changes but his game plan should be the same.
[list]
[*]Damage scale is slightly reduced
[*]Health is slightly increased
[*]Forward walk is slightly slower
[*]Forward dash doesn't go as far

[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/2789edef5fddc7c00557ab34419c5fabb43619c4.png[/img]
Maxx got a fair bit of changes but in general his game plan should also be the same.
[list]
[*]Damage scale is slightly reduced
[*]Forward walk when buffed and non-buffed is slower
[*]Backward walk when non-buffed is faster
[*]Forward dash doesn't go as far
[*]Forward throw doesn't throw as far
[*]St.LP has less push back
[*]Cr.LP has less push back
[*]Jp.LP is better on block
[*]St.LK is slower, has less range, has more push back, and has less hit and block stun
[*]Cr.LK is now special cancel-able, is now chain cancel-able into other lights, is slower, has more push back, and has more hit and block stun
[*]Jp.LK has a higher hit box, is worse on hit, and better on block
[*]St.MP is better on block
[*]Cr.MP is better again opponents directly above

[/list]

That's it for the main changes in the update, but there's a ton of other little changes sprinkled around. If you want to dive deep into the thorough patch notes, [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/12H4dT2EuvbvN3LsG_a8nO1Jk0Dz6CmoAFTws7nlhySs/edit?usp=sharing]you can find them here[/url]

Thanks so much to everyone in the discord who helped us test the lobby / spectating functionality. These things have a ton of moving parts and we are fortunate to have such a friendly and helpful community.

notes.title: Punch Planet - Version 0.3.3.c
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/dc06d994f73df5314a6654bd250faf139c433905.png[/img]
Version 0.3.3.c is now released! This is a small content update with some gameplay tweaks for ECT coming up this weekend.

[b]Notable changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjustments to jump velocities and how they relate to characters' walk speeds
[*]Proximity boxes added to all airborne attacks
[*]Some small input timing changes for some sequences
[*]Slightly higher reversal window, the decrease it got last patch was too much
[*]Removal of FXAA graphics option, generally looked worse when enabled
[*]Game now remains visible when not in focus. this can cause issues with exclusive fullscreen and using Alt+Tab, recommend using Alt+Enter to force windowed
[*]Game now mutes audio when not in focus
[*]Some gameplay tweaks for the cast
[*]Camera slightly farther out of the corners
[/list]

notes.title: Punch Planet - Version 0.3.3.a
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/f155ed7984cb6d42c9852bbcb627fdd1c0a610bf.png[/img]

Version 0.3.3 of Punch Planet is now released!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZDlHsMcrirI
[b]Music[/b]
Theme songs for Roy, Cid, and Tyara have been added, completing our current casts' music.
[list]
[*][url=https://soundcloud.com/punchplanet/on-the-run]Roy[/url]
[*][url=https://soundcloud.com/punchplanet/takingyouin]Cid[/url]
[*][url=https://soundcloud.com/punchplanet/thegoddessawakens]TYara[/url]
[/list]

[b]Motion Blur[/b]
Added an option for enabling motion blur, might affect your performance so keep that in mind when using.

[b]Bloom[/b]
The bloom values have been adjusted and ability to disable has been removed.

[b]Roy[/b]
Roy has had his entire animation library updated and some of his moves have changed as a result.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/964e9c6b0487b4a2285a41e21a365327f369ab68.gif[/img]
https://giphy.com/gifs/iqt3hI6VaVSNYXbvvZ

Notable changes:
[list]
[*]Jp.LP: Now uses old Jp.MP animation
[*]St.LK: Increased range, no longer a low
[*]Jp.LK: Adjusted hit boxes
[*]Fw.MP: No longer reels back during the startup, increased push back
[*]Jp.MP: New animation and data, cause a soft knockdown spike against airborne opponents
[*]St.MK: Reduced stun and range
[*]Jp.HP: Now causes a reset against airborne opponents
[*]St.HK: Ranges adjusted
[*]Jp.HK: New animation and data, causes a hard knockdown spike against airborne opponents (like his old Jp.HP)
[*]Headbutts: General range reduction in active and followthrough frames
[*]Super Punch: Now named Knuckle Sandwich
[/list]

[b]Cid[/b]
Cid's model has been updated with new boots, movable side grenades, and movable dog tags. Some of her animations have been updated to use these.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/bb5935346f7338f68f1666a80428bc14b80d4d1d.gif[/img]
https://giphy.com/gifs/1dGzUuubeQ5z3JacMF

Notable changes:
[list]
[*]Cr.LP: No longer chainable into other lights
[*]St.MP: Regular version is faster
[*]Jp.MK: Harder to combo from
[*]Cr.HP: Adjusted juggle physics
[*]St.HK: Faster
[*]Knife Wheel: All versions are now -4 on block
[/list]

[b]TYara[/b]
A few gameplay changes for the warrior goddess.

Notable changes:
[list]
[*]Cr.LP: Decreased startup by 1 frame, now in line with other characters
[*]St.MK: Only one of the two hits will land, only the later hit is cancellable into super
[*]M.Chop: Slightly faster
[*]Shield Charges: Heavier versions now provide slightly more knockdown frames
[*]Super Combo: Now named "War Dance"
[/list]

[b]Dog[/b]
Dog has received quite a few gameplay adjustments.

Notable changes:
[list]
[*]St.LK: Higher block stun
[*]Cr.LK: Higher block stun
[*]St.MP: Adjusted animation movement
[*]Cr.MP: Now hits low, animation now returns to start position
[*]Jp.MP: More active frames, harder to anti air, harder to combo from
[*]St.MK: Slightly faster, less recovery
[*]Cr.MK: Updated animation, decreased damage, adjusted hit boxes
[*]St.HP: Causes hard knockdown against airborne, increased juggle value, adjusted frame advantage
[*]Cr.HP: Faster, can combo from jab, can run stop into jab for free
[*]DwFw.HP: Causes hard knockdown, more punishable on block
[*]Jp.HP: Less hit stun, more block stun
[*]St.HK: Farther hit box
[*]Cr.HK: Increased damage, decreased active frames, harder to combo from, safer when blocked
[*]Run: Standardized initial startup velocities for all runs
[*]Run -> Stop: Slightly faster
[*]Run -> Leap Strike: Much higher knockdown frames
[*]Pin Wheel: Disabled different Dive versions (L / M / H, only one version now), increased the cancel window into Dive
[*]EX.Pin Wheel: Moves farther, only the initial frames will hit grounded opponents, decreased juggle value
[*]Pin Wheel -> Dive: Adjusted hit box
[/list]

[b]Agent-G[/b]
Agent-G can now feel the power flowing through him.

Notable changes:
[list]
[*]Cr.LK: Adjusted advantage
[*]Jp.MP: Better hit box
[*]St.MK: Increased damage
[*]Cr.MK: Hit box range retracted, hurt box range extended
[*]Jp.MK: Harder to combo from
[*]Jp.HP: Slightly faster, improved hit box
[*]St.HK: Improved hit box, animation movement adjusted
[*]Cr.HK: More damage
[*]Jp.HK: Less hit stun
[*]Crescent Kicks: Adjusted juggle physics, hit box range retracted
[*]Lunar Geyser: Is cooler
[/list]

[b]Maxx[/b]
Maxx received some new fun stuff.

Notable changes:
[list]
[*]St.LK: Adjusted advantage
[*]Cr.LK: Slightly less block stun
[*]Jp.LK: More active frames, adjusted stun
[*]Fw.MP: Moves farther forward
[*]Cr.HP: Less push back, more knockdown frames
[*]Fw.HP: Increased damage
[*]St.HK: Moves less far forward, extended hit box
[*]EX.Hook Swing: Decreased juggle value
[*]Horny Toad: Now projectile invincible during startup
[*]Buff-U: Decreased meter gain
[*]EX.Buff-U: Increased bottle hit box size, increased bottle stun values, slightly increased bottle damage
[/list]

[b]Battle Camera[/b]
Camera has been adjusted slightly to give a slightly more 3D look and have less vertical movement.

[b]Quick Rise[/b]
Quick rise / normal rise for soft knockdowns has effectively been disabled. Players that are put into a soft knockdown will now automatically rise at the old quick rise timing. Some moves have had their knockdown timings adjusted with this in mind. The difference now between soft and hard knockdown are the combo-ability and generally longer knockdown times.

[b]Chainable Light Attacks[/b]
For light attacks that chain into others, they have had their cancel windows delayed and adjusted. They are now -1 when being countered by an ATC and attempting to chain into their fastest light. This means when landing a successful ATC, the defender should almost always be at an advantage.

[b]Airborne Normals[/b]
Many airborne normals have had their hit stun decreased while having their block stun increased. This will make better followups require deeper jump ins.

[b]Throws[/b]
Normal throws are 1f slower. It will be easier to react to and will lose to strikes more often.

[b]ATC[/b]
When whiffing an ATC, the recovery frames have been reduced by 2 frames. It is slightly less risky to go for.

[b]JTC[/b]
JTC has been adjusted in a few ways. The hit stop has been increased, the landing recovery and stun values have been equally increased, and damage has been reduced. Functionally the move should remain the same but slightly less effective, also more punishable when countered by ATC.

[b]Unity[/b]
We've updated our version of Unity that we use from 5.5 to 5.6. Will have improved performance and fixed some known issues (like alt tabbing in exclusive fullscreen).

[b]DTC Advantage Flyup[/b]
With attack info turned on in training mode, a flyup similar to the hit advantage will show when using DTC.

[b]Loading Screen[/b]
There is one now.

[url=https://pastebin.com/raw/gwpCucHC]Full detail changelog[/url]

Thank you everyone for the continued support, please enjoy the set play.

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/3a86ebf87e4b2501f54005b88b8ba0c0d7ee3348.png[/img]

Version 0.3.2 of Punch Planet is now released! Last week at EVO was a ton of fun for us and it was so awesome seeing everyone that came out, thank you all for the support! This patch is mostly gameplay changes from feedback / observations we got at the event.

[b]Walk Speeds[/b]
Walk speeds have been slightly adjusted for all characters. Most characters had their backward speeds increased, and Roy / Cid have had their forward speed slightly reduced. Overall this should be a defensive buff to the neutral game.

[b]Jumps[/b]
All characters have had their horizontal jump distances slightly decreased, should make spacing against jump attacks slightly easier for the character on the ground and slightly reduce the effectiveness of jumping in.

[b]Airborne Attack Damage[/b]
Standardized the damage values on all jumping attacks so that it will be easier to balance in the future. Each airborne attack now references a shared value for its damage, and also allows for an offset to adjust on a per-move basis. Base values are Light = 20, Medium = 40, Heavy = 60.

[b]Maxx[/b]
Since he was just released, Maxx is still a little rough around the edges, most of his changes are geared towards bringing him a bit more in line in effectiveness and usability.
[list]
[*]Cr.LK: Now super cancellable
[*]Jp.LP / Jp.LK: Fixed doing way too much damage
[*]St.MP: Increased push back, increased hit box range
[*]St.MK: Decreased startup
[*]Cr.MK: Decreased hit / block stun
[*]St.HP: Increased push back, increased hit stun, decreased block stun
[*]Hook Swing: Increased damage on L / M versions
[*]Horny Toad: Increased damage, adjusted hit box
[*]G.A.P: Decreased projectile invincibility, adjusted hurt boxes (easier to hit), [*]decreased startup on H version, fixed double meter gain
[*]Buff-U: No longer gains meter on initial use (only when getting the buff)
[*]Last Call (Buffed): Decreased damage
[/list]
[b]Agent-G[/b]
Agent-G feels a bit weak in health and damage so we wanted to buff him up a little bit. I felt like he was already pretty strong, but the amount of work he has to do to get his wins feels a bit high compared to the other characters.
[list]
[*]Increased health
[*]Increased damage scale
[*]Cr.HP: Decreased damage
[*]Cr.HK: Increased hit box range
[*]Lunar Disk: Decreased horizontal spawn position of the projectile
[/list]
[b]Roy[/b]
Not a lot changing with Roy, just a buff to his Cr.HK so that it's slightly faster (combos from LP.Gunshot xx DTC now) and applies a longer knockdown
[list]
[*]Cr.HK: Decreased startup, increased knockdown frames, increased push back
[/list]
[b]Cid[/b]
Cid is strong
[list]
[*] Jp.MP (Charged): Adjusted juggle physics, decreased juggle value
[*] Cr.HP (Charged): Adjusted hop cancel physics and attack timing
[*] Cr.HK: Increased knockdown frames
[*] Grenade: Decreased horizontal spawn position of the projectile, decreased hit and block stun on L / M / H versions, increased x velocity of all versions, decreased active frames
[/list]

[b]Stage Music[/b]
Added training mode versions of all stage tracks, which are just longer versions and incorporate the entire songs. The tracks used for gameplay are broken up into Round 1 / Round 2 (sound difference) but in training you would only ever hear the Round 1 version, now you'll hear the entire track.

[b]Input[/b]
Decreased input leniency when coming out of a Dash. This was done specifically to make it easier to do Agent-G Dash -> Legendary Sentai, but there really didn't need to be as much leniency as there was.

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with the battle camera that would cause the depth of field to become enabled after a rollback, even when it was disabled in the settings. Should help with slowdowns on lower-end machines when doing command grabs / super freeze.
[*]Fixed an issue when checking for collisions that could allow a command grab to hit on the same frame as a projectile, causing undesired issues..
[*]Fixed a bug when using projectiles that caused them not to record their start frame correctly, fixes a bug with using a projectile for the first time in a game.
[*]Fixed any instances of KO sequences using soft knockdown instead of hard, fixes any cases of players being able to quick rise after a KO
[/list]

Full and detailed changelog can be found [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1e8F-Cf6djIHSB8IK_YtOwWfDk2GARP9Deq4mQ11nZ6g/edit?usp=sharing]here[/url] or below:

      * Similar to how CH / Block damage can be specified, allows the base damage of an attack to be able to be defined as a composite of values

      * Most of the time it will just be the Normal Damage (Extra = 0)
      * Can allow tying an attacks damage to a generic damage value (ie, Damage_Light_Airborne instead of just "20") but also allow defining an extra variance
      * Useful if we want an attack to be like Damage_Light_Airborne + 10, so that if the base value changes it can still affect things that want to reference it (like an offset)

notes.title: Punch Planet - Maxx Release - Version 0.3.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/36e9391ca4c397a943456edfb422f3d9d6a0522b.png[/img]

Version 0.3 of Punch Planet is now released! With this update comes our sixth character [b]Maxx[/b], the Froggy Bouncer, who is our first charge character to appear in the game. Along with him, there are some small changes for the other characters, visual changes to some universal mechanics (Quick Rise / Counter Hits), improvements to the input system, new music, and more optimizations to the engine like always.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30948716/02ff8cfca8d42daa918b342aa0e6f2373fc7066f.png[/img]

https://youtu.be/EH4UaYv6GZ0

[b]Maxx[/b]
Maxx is a big-body brawler with solid hit confirms, a sneaky command grab, and big beefy attacks.

[b]Hook Swing[/b]
[b]Input:[/b] (charge)Backwards -> Forwards + Punch
[list]
[*]Light version is the fastest but allows the least amount of follow-ups
[*]Medium version is slower but gives more options on hit
[*]Heavy version causes a hard knockdown but is hard to combo into
[*]EX version has two hits, first hit keeps standing and second hit launches
[*]All versions are cancellable into SUPER and DTC
[*]All versions gain armor when Maxx is buffed into the air for many followups
[/list]
https://youtu.be/OZfSocWI-v4

[b]Ground & Pound[/b]
[b]Input:[/b] (charge)Backwards -> Forwards + Kick
[list]
[*]Normal versions vary in distance and speed
[*]EX version is very close range and fastest
[*]All versions gain armor when Maxx is buffed
[*]All versions can cancel last hit into DTC (follow-up into an OTG attack)
[/list]
https://youtu.be/GMGFhu6kk6g

[b]Horny Toad[/b]
[b]Input:[/b] (charge)Down -> Up + Punch
[list]
[*]Light version is low range
[*]Medium version is farther
[*]Heavy version is long range
[*]EX version has armor on frame 1 (reversal)
[*]All versions gain armor when Maxx is buffed
[*]Cannot cancel into SUPER or DTC
[/list]
https://youtu.be/52wqLSXo66Y

[b]Buff-U[/b]
[b]Input:[/b] Half-Circle-Backwards (HCB) + Kick
[list]
[*]Gain a temporary buff that gives armor to the next used special attack (Hook Swing, G.A.P, Horny Toad)
[*]Buff is removed after using one of the above moves
[*]Buff is removed when hit (not on block)
[*]L / M / H versions are identical
[*]EX version throws the bottle as a low-damage projectile
[*]All versions are cancellable into DTC
[/list]
https://youtu.be/R-Tzfz71o-0

[b]Last Call[/b]
[b]Input:[/b] (charge)Backwards -> Forwards -> Backwards -> Forwards + Punch
[list]
[*]There are two versions, one when buffed and one when not buffed
[*]Costs 2 EX-bars
[*]Normal version is a multi hit
[*]Buffed version is single hit, faster and does more damage
[/list]
https://youtu.be/yGByu2P1IAU

[b]Happy Hour[/b]
[b]Input:[/b] Triggers automatically at full EX-meter
[list]
[*]Gains Buff-U buff until the end of the round
[*]Also gains armor on grounded heavy attacks (St.HP / Cr.HP / St.HK / Cr.HK)
[*]Meter is fully removed at the end of the round (stays full after activation, starts at zero next round)
[*]Advantage is net-zero when activated (same advantage after activation as before)
[/list]
https://youtu.be/hoJ7PJ-RJ6o

[b]Music[/b]
We've added selectable music for Dog, Agent-G, and Maxx

[b]Counter Hits[/b]
Counter hits have been visually improved a bit. When players are counter hit, they will now flash red, a unique sound is played, and the camera is shaken a bit. These changes should help distinguish the CH situation and make it easier for players to recognize.

[b]Quick Rise[/b]
Similar to counter hits, when a player quick rises they will now flash blue. This should also help the situation become more apparent when it happens.

[b]Input[/b]
Fixed a bug that was causing specials to not trigger, when holding a lower button.

[b]Game Effects[/b]
Some optimizations and improvements to objects that use the game effect logic (basically anytime there is a visual effect use with a move). These are now much easier to use on our end and should be more performant when rolling back (faster and more consistent).
